meta_description: In her Second State of the Nation Address, President Claudia Sheinbaum reports on nearly two years of the Fourth Transformation: record real wages, expanded Well-Being Programs, restored energy and water sovereignty, a 51% drop in homicides, and an unyielding defense of Mexico's sovereignty.
